release.release_notes:
Gaia Settings now provides scoped RetroArch Video, Audio, Saves & resume and Controllers preferences, including rotation, threaded video, latency/synchronization, automatic states, save intervals/slots and player/autodetection options. Per-setting help explains defaults, inheritance and support; settings apply on the next game launch.

Gaia-styled Light/Dark dialogs and action buttons now cover settings information, emulator readiness, advanced-frontend confirmation, reset confirmation and display Keep/Revert. Long preference lists scroll with controller selection; routine successful changes stay quiet.

Validation: 61 Python cases, 20 authored QML syntax checks, four native CTest suites, hidden Qt settings flow and native UI/input/update/theme/persistence probes. The initial update-retry probe timed out in the full build job; a short runtime-only replay of the same retained native binary passed the complete suite without product changes or recompilation. Native Light/Dark captures use Xvfb and Mesa OpenGL. No game, VM/device, ISO installation or physical audio/controller acceptance is claimed; Chris owns those checks.

This is a Debian 13 amd64 launcher/application update. It does not replace the base system or installer image. Beta channel only; Stable unchanged.

Exact built source: c08e80d78d6e2204a72cad5d2181d7ec88e6d425. Native build/check/captures run: https://github.com/t4kas/GaiaOS/actions/runs/41429568432 . Full UI replay: https://github.com/t4kas/GaiaOS/actions/runs/41431116419 .
